about: Sidney is a town on the Saanich Peninsula north of Victoria, British Columbia, on the Salish Sea near Victoria International Airport and the Swartz Bay ferry terminal. Bookstores, a harbour waterfront, and a role as a peninsula service and tourist town define the community. About 12,000 people live in Sidney.
seoSummary: Saanich Peninsula town north of Victoria—harbour, bookstores, and gateway near the airport and Swartz Bay ferries.
